key: Battery Capacity Estimator (Least Squares, Variable Weights)
title: Battery Capacity Estimator (Least Squares, Variable Weights)
text: Battery capacity estimator using least-squares algorithms and variable weights, 5 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Specify Current input as cell current(s)} sets the option to specify current input port, {Least square algorithm} sets the least-square algorithm Ordinary least, {SOC change detection threshold} sets the threshold to detect change in SOC, {Forgetting factor, gamma}, {Scaling factor k in VarianceX=k^2*VarianceY} and {Algorithm data type} sets the option to choose data type for block algorithm. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: CellSOC
ports.summary: Cell state of charge, unitless scalar | vector

ports.name: VarianceSOC
ports.summary: Variance of SOC, unitless positive scalar | vector of positive values

ports.name: VarianceCurrent
ports.summary: Variance of current measurement, unitless positive scalar | vector of positive values

ports.name: InitialCellAH
ports.summary: Initial cell capacity, A*Hr scalar | vector

ports.name: CellAH
ports.summary: Estimated cell capacity, A*Hr scalar | vector

params.name: Specify Current input as cell current(s)
params.values: Option to specify current input port as vector off (default) | on

params.name: Least square algorithm
params.values: Least-square algorithm Ordinary least squares (default) | Recursive total least squares | Approximate total least squares

params.name: SOC change detection threshold
params.values: Threshold to detect change in SOC 0.03 (default) | scalar in the range (0,1)

params.name: Forgetting factor, gamma
